node.title: Prize N=256 square-mass-18 m=16 high-variance exclusion
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, a profile-(4,2,0) collision with cofactor 16 cannot have V in {114,122,130,138,146,154,162,170,178}. A profile-specific autocorrelation L1 bound, six quadratic log majorants, and three exact layered-third-moment Hermite certificates leave only 10<=V<=106 with V=2 mod 8.
node.notes: ANALYTIC ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-28: removes the high nine of 22 m=16 variance chambers without relying on the accompanying census. Lower variances, cofactors 2 and 4, and the aggregate weighted edge count remain open.
